aliases: 熊猫酒店最后一个上午
query: Chimelong Panda Hotel, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Panda-themed resort hotel next to Chimelong Safari Park and Happy World.
summary.zh: 紧邻长隆野生动物世界和欢乐世界的熊猫主题度假酒店。

why.en: Guests may enter Safari Park 30 minutes before general visitors via the North Gate, which is when queues for the safari train are shortest. Free shuttles run to every park, so no taxis are needed for three days. Lobby, corridors and rooms are panda-themed throughout.
why.zh: 住客可比一般游客提前半小时从北门进入野生动物世界，小火车排队最短就在这段时间。免费接驳车通往各个园区，三天不用打车。大堂、走廊和客房全是熊猫主题。

en: Early Safari Park entry for guests (North Gate)
Free shuttles from 2F to each park
Panda décor and kids' area for photos
zh: 二楼坐免费接驳车去各园区
熊猫装饰和儿童区，适合拍照

tips.en: Check-in from 15:00, checkout by 12:00. Shuttle departure point (2F) should be confirmed at reception.
tips.zh: 15:00后入住，12:00前退房。接驳车上车点（二楼）以前台说明为准。

name.zh: From·K Hotel 体育西路地铁站店

query: From K Hotel Tiyu Xilu Metro Station, Tianhe, Guangzhou

summary.en: Tianhe base by Tiyu Xilu metro, ~10 min walk to Grandview Mall.
summary.zh: 天河体育西路地铁站旁，步行约10分钟到正佳广场。

why.en: Tiyu Xilu is an interchange of Metro Lines 1 and 3, so most of the city is one ride away. Grandview, Teemall, Parc Central and Fashion Tianhe are all within a 10-minute walk.
why.zh: 体育西路是地铁1号线和3号线换乘站，去市内大部分地方一程可达。正佳、天河城、天环广场和时尚天河都在步行10分钟内。

en: Metro Lines 1 and 3 at the door
Walking distance to Tianhe's main malls
zh: 门口就是地铁1号线、3号线
步行可到天河主要商场

tips.en: Navigate to “From K Hotel 体育西路”. Exact entrance and branch should be confirmed on Amap (高德).
tips.zh: 导航“From K Hotel 体育西路”；具体入口和门店以高德为准。

query: Chimelong Panda Hotel restaurant, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: In-hotel dining with panda-shaped cakes and buffet meals.
summary.zh: 酒店内餐厅，有自助餐和熊猫造型蛋糕。

why.en: No travel is needed between park and meal, which matters on show nights. Panda-shaped desserts are made here and are a photo the kids will ask for.
why.zh: 不用出门就能吃，有演出的晚上最省时间。熊猫造型甜点在这里做，孩子一定会要拍。

tips.en: The hotel has more than one outlet; exact restaurant names and hours should be checked at reception. Buffet is crowded at opening even in low season.
tips.zh: 酒店有多个餐厅，具体名称和营业时间以前台为准；自助餐淡季开门时也很挤。

query: Chimelong Panda Hotel lobby bar, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Lobby lounge for Western cakes and hot drinks.
summary.zh: 大堂吧，西式蛋糕和热饮。

why.en: A seated break between the resort walk and check-in, in the panda-decorated lobby.
why.zh: 熟悉度假区之后、入住之前，可以在熊猫装饰的大堂坐下休息。

name.zh: 长隆酒店白虎自助餐厅

query: White Tiger Buffet Restaurant, Chimelong Hotel, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Buffet beside the Chimelong Hotel's white tiger enclosure.
summary.zh: 长隆酒店内、紧邻白虎栖息地的自助餐厅。

why.en: White tigers are watched through the glass while eating, which turns a meal into a sight. The spread is wide: Cantonese roasts, seafood, desserts.
why.zh: 隔着玻璃边吃边看白虎，一顿饭也是一个景点。菜式丰富，有烧味、海鲜、甜品。

en: White tigers visible from the tables
Short shuttle ride from the Panda Hotel
zh: 从熊猫酒店坐接驳车很近

tips.en: In the Chimelong Hotel, not the Panda Hotel. Booking ahead is advised; price and tiger viewing times are not confirmed.
tips.zh: 在长隆酒店，不在熊猫酒店；建议提前订位，价格和看白虎的时段未确认。

query: Wanbo CBD, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Panyu's main mall district, ~15 min by taxi from Chimelong.
summary.zh: 番禺主要商圈，离长隆打车约15分钟。

why.en: The nearest place to Chimelong with ordinary city prices: chain teahouses, Cantonese restaurants and several large malls.
why.zh: 离长隆最近、价格正常的地方：连锁茶楼、粤菜馆，还有几个大型商场。

tips.en: A district, not a single venue; a specific restaurant should be chosen on Dianping before leaving. Specific malls are not verified.
tips.zh: 是一个商圈不是单一地点，出发前在大众点评选好餐厅；具体商场未核实。

query: Chimelong Safari Park, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: China's largest safari park: pandas, koalas, white tigers, a safari train and cable car.
summary.zh: 国内规模最大的野生动物园之一：熊猫、考拉、白虎、小火车和缆车。

why.en: Giant pandas, including the world's only surviving panda triplets born here in 2014, are seen up close. Elephants and giraffes are fed by hand, and the safari train passes free-roaming herds. A full day is filled for every age.
why.zh: 可以近距离看大熊猫，包括2014年在这里出生、全球唯一存活的熊猫三胞胎。可以亲手喂大象和长颈鹿，小火车穿过放养的动物群。各年龄段都能玩满一天。

en: Cable car over the whole park
zh: 熊猫乐园看熊猫三胞胎

tips.en: Panda Hotel guests enter 30 min early via the North Gate. Queue times are shown in the official Chimelong app.
tips.zh: 熊猫酒店住客可从北门提前半小时入园；长隆官方APP有各馆排队时间。

name.zh: 长隆野生动物世界小火车

query: Chimelong Safari Park train station, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: ~35 min seated loop through the big-cat, giraffe and zebra areas.
summary.zh: 约35分钟坐着绕园，经过猛兽区、长颈鹿和斑马。

why.en: The open plains, where animals roam rather than sit in pens, are only reached this way. Queues pass 1 hour by mid-morning, so it is done first.
why.zh: 动物放养的大片区域只能坐小火车进去。上午晚些排队超过1小时，所以第一个去。

en: Lions, tigers and bears from the train

tips.en: Go straight to the station at entry.
tips.zh: 入园后直奔小火车站。

query: Panda Paradise, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: Giant panda enclosures, home of the Chimelong panda triplets.
summary.zh: 大熊猫馆，长隆熊猫三胞胎的家。

why.en: Pandas are most active in the morning, eating bamboo and climbing. The triplets Mengmeng, Shuaishuai and Kuku were born here in 2014.
why.zh: 熊猫上午最活跃，吃竹子、爬树。萌萌、帅帅、酷酷三胞胎2014年在这里出生。

tips.en: Visit before 11:00 for active pandas.
tips.zh: 11点前去，熊猫最活跃。

query: Koala Park, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: One of the largest koala groups outside Australia.
summary.zh: 澳洲以外规模最大的考拉种群之一。

why.en: Koalas are rarely seen outside Australia; dozens live here. They sleep most of the day, so a morning visit gives the best chance of movement.
why.zh: 澳洲以外很少能看到考拉，这里有几十只。它们大部分时间在睡，上午最有机会看到动。

query: White Tiger, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: Enclosure for Chimelong's large white Bengal tiger group.
summary.zh: 长隆白虎（白色孟加拉虎）展区。

why.en: Chimelong keeps one of the world's largest groups of white tigers. They are seen at close range through glass.
why.zh: 长隆有全球数量最多的白虎群之一，隔着玻璃近距离看。

name.zh: 长隆野生动物世界熊猫餐厅

query: Panda Restaurant, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: In-park themed restaurant serving panda-shaped dishes.
summary.zh: 园内主题餐厅，熊猫造型餐点。

why.en: Rice, buns and desserts are shaped like pandas, which keeps kids eating on a long park day. Seating indoors gives a proper rest at midday.
why.zh: 饭团、包子、甜点都做成熊猫造型，孩子在园里走了半天也愿意吃。室内有座位，中午能好好休息。

en: Panda rice set (熊猫饭团套餐)

tips.en: Exact menu and location within the park are not verified; arrive by 11:45 to beat the rush.
tips.zh: 具体菜单和园内位置未核实；11:45前到，避开人潮。

query: Asian Elephant, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: Elephant enclosure where bananas can be bought and fed by hand.
summary.zh: 可以买香蕉亲手喂大象的展区。

why.en: An elephant's trunk takes the banana from your hand, an encounter most kids remember for years. Feeding is done from a raised platform.
why.zh: 大象用鼻子从手里卷走香蕉，孩子会记很多年。在高台上投喂，安全。

tips.en: Feed price is set on site.
tips.zh: 投喂食物价格以现场为准。

query: Giraffe Plaza, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: Raised deck for feeding giraffes at head height.
summary.zh: 高台上与长颈鹿平视投喂。

why.en: Giraffes are met eye to eye and fed leaves by hand, the park's most popular activity. The herd is one of the largest in China.
why.zh: 和长颈鹿面对面、亲手喂树叶，是全园最受欢迎的项目；这里的长颈鹿群是国内最大的之一。

tips.en: Queues are long; one adult can queue while the others rest. Feed is sold separately.
tips.zh: 排队长，可以一人排队其他人休息；食物另外买。

name.zh: 长隆野生动物世界空中缆车

query: Cable car, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: ~30 min loop over the park.
summary.zh: 约30分钟环园缆车。

why.en: The whole park, including the animal plains, is seen from above while seated, which doubles as an afternoon rest.
why.zh: 坐着从高处看全园和放养区，也是下午的休息时间。

query: Flamingo Lake, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: Lake with a large flamingo flock near the exit, beside the gift shops.
summary.zh: 出口附近的火烈鸟湖，旁边是纪念品店。

why.en: Hundreds of pink flamingos make the last photo of the day. Souvenir shops are on the way out.
why.zh: 几百只粉色火烈鸟，是当天最后一张照片；出园路上就有纪念品店。

query: Chimelong Food Town, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: À la carte food court in the Chimelong resort.
summary.zh: 长隆度假区内的单点美食区。

why.en: Shorter queues than the hotel buffets, with a choice of Cantonese and fast-food stalls so each person picks their own.
why.zh: 比酒店自助餐少排队，有粤菜和快餐档口，各人点自己想吃的。

tips.en: Exact location within the resort is not verified; it should be confirmed at reception.
tips.zh: 在度假区内的具体位置未核实，以前台说明为准。

query: Chimelong Tourist Resort, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Evening drone light show at the resort (dates to be confirmed).
summary.zh: 度假区夜间无人机灯光表演（日期待确认）。

why.en: Hundreds of drones form shapes over the resort after dark; it is free to watch for hotel guests and ends the day without more walking.
why.zh: 几百架无人机在度假区夜空组成图案；住客免费观看，不用再走远路。

tips.en: Dates, time, location and whether it is free are unconfirmed; they should be checked with reception or the Chimelong app.
tips.zh: 日期、时间、地点和是否免费均未确认，以前台或长隆APP为准。

aliases: 大马戏剧场、欢乐世界北门
query: Chimelong International Circus, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: ~80 min circus with animals and aerial acrobatics, next to Happy World North Gate.
summary.zh: 约80分钟的大型马戏，有动物和高空杂技，在欢乐世界北门旁。

why.en: Performers from many countries in a theatre for several thousand people, with animal acts, motorbike globes and aerial work. Scale and effects are well beyond a typical circus.
why.zh: 来自多个国家的演员，几千人的剧场，有动物表演、摩托车飞球和高空节目，规模和效果远超一般马戏。

en: Huge theatre, strong lighting and sound
Next to the Panda Hotel shuttle
zh: 熊猫酒店坐接驳车就到

tips.en: Doors 17:00; standard seats unassigned, so arrive 45+ min early on holidays. Original booking ID is checked. Not recommended for under-3s or children under 1 m.
tips.zh: 17:00开放入场，普通座不对号，节假日至少提前45分钟；验证购票证件原件；未满3岁或1米以下儿童不建议入场。

query: Chimelong Paradise, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Theme park with major roller coasters and a large kids' area.
summary.zh: 有多台大型过山车和大面积儿童区的主题乐园。

why.en: Thrill seekers get world-class coasters, including a vertical dive coaster and a ten-inversion coaster, while younger kids have a separate gentle-ride zone, so the family splits and meets for lunch.
why.zh: 喜欢刺激的有垂直过山车、十环过山车等大型项目；小朋友有专门的温和项目区，两组分开玩，中午会合。

tips.en: Queues are shortest in the first two hours. Water rides are best skipped in December.
tips.zh: 开园头两小时排队最短；12月天冷，湿身项目建议跳过。

query: Scream Zone, Chimelong Paradise, Guangzhou

summary.en: High-speed launched coaster just inside the North Gate.
summary.zh: 北门进去就到的高速弹射过山车。

why.en: One of the park's most popular rides; done at opening, the queue is a fraction of the afternoon wait.
why.zh: 全园最热门的项目之一，开园就去，排队只是下午的零头。

tips.en: Official English name and height limit are not verified; check signage.
tips.zh: 官方英文名和身高限制未核实，以现场标示为准。

query: Tornado ride, Chimelong Paradise, Guangzhou

summary.en: Spinning thrill ride in the Scream Zone.
summary.zh: 尖叫地带的旋转刺激项目。

why.en: Right next to the Rocket Coaster, so it is ridden straight after with no walking.
why.zh: 就在火箭过山车旁边，玩完直接排，不用走路。

tips.en: Ride type and restrictions are not verified.
tips.zh: 项目类型和限制未核实。

query: Dive Coaster, Chimelong Paradise, Guangzhou

summary.en: B&M dive coaster with a 90° vertical drop.
summary.zh: B&M垂直过山车，90度垂直俯冲。

why.en: The train is held at the edge before a 90° drop, the park's signature thrill and one of the first dive coasters in China (opened 2006).
why.zh: 车厢在顶端悬停后90度垂直俯冲，是园区的招牌项目，也是国内最早的垂直过山车之一（2006年开放）。

tips.en: Loose items go in a locker.
tips.zh: 随身物品放储物柜。

query: Super pendulum, Chimelong Paradise, Guangzhou

summary.en: Giant swinging pendulum with full 360° rotation.
summary.zh: 可360度翻转的巨型摆锤。

why.en: Swings past horizontal and turns riders fully upside down; short queue compared with the coasters.
why.zh: 摆过水平线、整圈倒转，排队通常比过山车短。

tips.en: Phones and wallets go in a locker first.
tips.zh: 手机钱包先放储物柜。

query: Star Dream Garden, Chimelong Paradise, Guangzhou

summary.en: Family ride zone with carousel and bouncing rides.
summary.zh: 亲子项目区，有转马和跳跳类项目。

why.en: Gentle rides grouped close together, so younger children ride many times with little walking or queuing.
why.zh: 温和项目集中在一起，小朋友少走路、少排队，可以玩很多次。

tips.en: Ride list per the 2026 official map; English name is a translation.
tips.zh: 项目以官方地图为准；英文名为意译。

query: Coconut Grove Restaurant, Chimelong Paradise, Guangzhou

summary.en: Sit-down restaurant inside Happy World, on the official route.
summary.zh: 欢乐世界内的餐厅，官方路线推荐。

why.en: A seated meal in the park where both groups regroup; recommended on Chimelong's official route.
why.zh: 园内能坐下吃饭、两组会合的地方，长隆官方路线推荐。

tips.en: Menu not verified; arrive by 11:30.
tips.zh: 菜单未核实；11:30前到。

query: Happy Theatre, Chimelong Paradise, Guangzhou

summary.en: Seated indoor magic show with audience interaction.
summary.zh: 有观众互动的室内魔术表演。

why.en: An indoor, seated break after a morning of rides, with children often called on stage.
why.zh: 玩了一上午后坐下休息，孩子常被请上台互动。

tips.en: Times per the Chimelong app; official guides mention ~14:00 and 16:30.
tips.zh: 场次以长隆APP为准，官方攻略提过约14:00和16:30。

query: Shawan Ancient Town, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: 800-year-old Lingnan town with ancestral halls, a pagoda and a weekend night market.
summary.zh: 800多年历史的岭南古镇，有祠堂、古塔和周末夜市。

why.en: Founded in the Southern Song, it keeps wok-ear gabled houses, flagstone lanes and the He clan's great ancestral hall. Ginger milk curd originated here. Compact and free, it is walked in two hours.
why.zh: 南宋始建，保留镬耳屋、石板街和何氏大宗祠；姜撞奶的发源地。古镇不大、免费，两小时可以走完。

tips.en: Flagstone streets; wear comfortable shoes and bring a jacket for the evening.
tips.zh: 石板路，穿好走的鞋；晚上冷，带外套。

query: Liugeng Hall, Shawan Ancient Town, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Five-courtyard Yuan-era ancestral hall, with an evening 3D projection on its façade.
summary.zh: 始建于元代的五进大祠堂，晚上外墙有3D投影。

why.en: One of the largest ancestral halls in the Pearl River Delta, with massive timber columns, the “诗书世泽” plaque and oyster-shell windows. After dark, a projection on the façade tells the town's musical history.
why.zh: 珠三角最大的祠堂之一，有巨大木柱、“诗书世泽”牌匾和蚝壳窗；入夜外墙投影讲古镇的音乐故事。

tips.en: Projection schedule is not confirmed; check on site.
tips.zh: 投影是否放映以现场为准。

query: Wenfeng Pagoda, Shawan Ancient Town, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Seven-storey pagoda overlooking the old town's wok-ear rooftops.
summary.zh: 七层古塔，可俯瞰古镇镬耳屋顶。

why.en: The best view of Shawan's rooftops, with wind chimes ringing at dusk. Nearby lanes hold the old pawnshop, Jinshi Gate and old rice mill.
why.zh: 看沙湾屋顶的最佳位置，黄昏风铃作响；附近古街有当楼、进士第门楼和老米机。

en: Old pawnshop and rice mill nearby

query: Anning Square, Shawan Ancient Town, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Evening craft market, ~17:30–19:00.
summary.zh: 傍晚手作市集，约17:30至19:00。

why.en: Local embroidery, copperware and tea are sold by makers under lights; the adjacent Guangdong Music Hall has weekend performances.
why.zh: 灯光下卖本地刺绣、铜器和茶叶；旁边的广东音乐馆周末有表演。

tips.en: Market days and hours are not confirmed for late December.
tips.zh: 12月下旬是否开市及时间未确认。

aliases: 沙湾姜撞奶老屋甜品店

name.en: Shawan Ginger Milk Curd Old House
name.zh: 沙湾姜撞奶老屋甜品店

query: 姜撞奶 甜品 沙湾古镇, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Dessert shop in a century-old house with a courtyard.
summary.zh: 百年老屋改的甜品店，有小院子。

why.en: Ginger milk curd was invented in Shawan: hot buffalo milk is poured onto fresh ginger juice and sets in seconds. Eating it in the town of origin, in a courtyard house, is the point of the evening.
why.zh: 姜撞奶起源于沙湾：热水牛奶冲进鲜姜汁，几秒就凝固。在发源地的老屋小院里吃，是这一晚的重点。

en: Origin town of ginger milk curd

tips.en: Shop name as given in the itinerary; exact shopfront should be confirmed on Dianping.
tips.zh: 店名按行程；具体门店以大众点评为准。

query: Grandview Mall, Tianhe Road, Tianhe, Guangzhou

summary.en: One of Guangzhou's largest malls, with themed floors, an aquarium and a polar museum.
summary.zh: 广州最大的商场之一，楼层各有主题，还有海洋馆和极地展馆。

why.en: Shopping, dining and kids' attractions are combined under one roof: sports brands on 3F, restaurants on 5F–7F, and an indoor aquarium. Ten minutes on foot from the hotel.
why.zh: 购物、吃饭和亲子景点都在一个屋檐下：三楼运动品牌，五至七楼餐厅，还有室内海洋馆。离酒店步行10分钟。

en: Connected to Teemall and Parc Central nearby
zh: 附近有天河城和天环广场

aliases: 午餐：陶陶居（正佳广场店）

name.en: Tao Tao Ju, Grandview Mall branch

query: 陶陶居 正佳广场店, Tianhe, Guangzhou

summary.en: Branch of the 1880-founded teahouse, on Grandview 6F (unit 6C059).
summary.zh: 创于1880年的老字号茶楼分店，正佳广场六楼6C059号铺。

why.en: Tao Tao Ju has served Cantonese dim sum since 1880 and is one of Guangzhou's most famous teahouse names. This branch gives the same menu without the trip to the old city.
why.zh: 陶陶居1880年起做广式点心，是广州最有名的茶楼老字号之一；这家分店菜单一样，不用回老城。

tips.en: Sunday lunch is busy; call to check the queue: 020-38373301.
tips.zh: 周日午市人多，先打电话问排队：020-38373301。

query: Fashion Tianhe, Tianhe Sports Center, Guangzhou

summary.en: Underground mall beneath Tianhe Sports Center for anime, collectible toys and budget fashion.
summary.zh: 天河体育中心地下商场，动漫、潮玩和平价服饰集中。

why.en: Anime merchandise, blind boxes and designer toys are concentrated in one underground mall, at lower prices than the big malls above.
why.zh: 动漫周边、盲盒和潮玩集中在一个地下商场，价格比楼上大商场低。

tips.en: ~10 min walk from Grandview. Children should be accompanied.
tips.zh: 从正佳步行约10分钟；小孩要有人陪同。

name.en: Chinese restaurant, Guangzhou Marriott Hotel Tianhe
name.zh: 广州正佳万豪酒店中餐厅

query: Guangzhou Marriott Hotel Tianhe Chinese restaurant, Tianhe Road, Guangzhou

summary.en: Hotel Cantonese restaurant beside Grandview Mall.
summary.zh: 正佳广场旁的酒店粤菜餐厅。

why.en: A proper sit-down Cantonese dinner with hotel-level service, a few minutes' walk from the K Hotel.
why.zh: 酒店水准的正式粤菜晚餐，离K Hotel步行几分钟。

tips.en: Restaurant name and menu are not verified; booking ahead is advised.
tips.zh: 餐厅名称和菜单未核实，建议提前订位。
